svg.title: OSDU Delivery: Deployment diagram for OSDU Delivery on Azure Container Apps
svg.desc: One resource group per environment, as osdu/deploy/terraform declares it; every app reaches Azure with its own managed identity.
svg.text: Deployment diagram for OSDU Delivery on Azure Container Apps
One resource group per environment, as osdu/deploy/terraform declares it; every app reaches Azure with its own managed identity.

g.title: MCP server: osdu-delivery-mcp, a Model Context Protocol server: SQLFlow's server composed with the delivery module. Every assistant reads its instructions; it answers from metadata, and from data only for a ! question through a read-only query over what an approved AI context opens. It holds no credential: it forwards each caller's token.

Workbench GUI: SQLFlow's workbench with the module's pages registered through the GUI module contract: pipelines and runs, lineage, the ledger and its records, the explorer of what OSDU holds, assertions, dimensions, inventories, templates, caches and the chat assistant. A static single-page app served by nginx; it calls the control plane's API.

Control plane: SQLFlow's control plane (.NET 9) with DeliveryControlPlaneModule: the REST API (the delivery API under /api/v1/delivery), identity and tokens, the managed git sync, schedules, the run queue and dispatcher, the node protocol, the chat assistant, and the module's background services. It decides what runs and owns the state; it runs no flow itself.

Compute node: SqlFlow.Delivery.Worker.Host: SQLFlow's worker with the module installed. It takes its work outbound from the control plane, so it can sit next to the data, and reads and writes the ledger in the osdu schema through the catalog's connection.

Catalog database: OsduDelivery: SQLFlow's catalog (pipelines, runs, schedules, lineage, users, conversations) and, beside it, the osdu schema with its own migrations: the ledger, the audit trail, cache versions, the index of the repository's templates, partitions and the central configuration.

Ingestion database: OsduData: the pre tables a file flow lands its files into, the keyed ingestion tables an ing flow upserts (stamping UpdatedDate_DW) and a delivery flow reads incrementally, and the tables dimension flows build. Snapshot isolation must be on.

Landing storage: A storage account with a hierarchical namespace and shared keys off, container landing. Every run is given its location as LANDING_URL (abfss://landing@<account>.dfs.core.windows.net): the source files the file flows land, the bulk payload files deliveries send, and work batch files when a flow writes them there.

AI Foundry: Created only when ai_foundry_name is set: an AIServices account, the project osdu-delivery and a model deployment (gpt-5.1 in the shipped environments), with an optional transcription deployment. Where prompts are processed follows the SKU: GlobalStandard, DataZoneStandard (EU or US) or Standard (the account's region).

Key Vault: osdu-kv-<suffix>, RBAC only. Terraform writes the connection strings (no credential in them); the setup script generates the JWT signing key, the first admin's password and the node token when missing; a person puts in each partition's client secret and the GitHub App's key.
Log Analytics: The apps' logs, kept 30 days.

Managed identities: osdu-delivery-control-plane-id, -worker-id, -gui-id and -mcp-id, and osdu-delivery-setup, which no app runs as. Each app reaches SQL, the vault, the storage and the model keylessly with its own identity.
g.text: One per app and one for

g.title: Container registry: Created by hand once per environment, read by the Terraform; every app pulls its image with AcrPull.
Setup scripts: Two AzurePowerShell deployment scripts, run as the setup identity on every apply: one generates the secrets the vault lacks, the other creates the apps' database users and grants.

App registration: OSDU Delivery: a single-page app registration whose redirect URI is the GUI's address, with one app role, SqlFlow.User, and assignment required, so nobody signs in until a group or person is assigned.

OSDU data platform: A data partition's core services (Storage, Search, Schema, Legal, File, Dataset, Workflow, Entitlements) and its domain data management services (Wellbore, Reservoir over ETP, Production), which hold the delivered records and their bulk data.
